title: Is this package deprecated? I'm interested in helping revive this
description:
Our group uses learnr and would have an interest in seeing this package revived if possible. But I see not much has happened in 5 years and it isn't on CRAN so I'm hesitant to start using this package as is. 

I'd be happy to talk about collaborating on this! Let me know.

title: How to change 'Drag from here' and 'Construct your solution here' labels?
description:
I'd like to translate them in French. Other labels can be modified within `question_parsons`, but apparently not these ones.

I tried with a parameter `text = c('drag alternative','construct alternative')` but in vain.

title: Change default submit_button text
description:
First, thanks for making this package! It's fantastic for teaching control flow in learnr tutorials in R.

One default that is confusing is the `submit_button` value being set to "Give feedback", which sounds like you're giving feedback on the learnr tutorial as a whole. It would make more sense for the default to be "Check answer". Thanks!

title: Do not reset question on "try again"
description:
The question should behave like a typical programming IDE, i.e. the current answer shouldn't reset after requesting feedback.

This will be possible once https://github.com/rstudio/learnr/issues/249 is implemented.

title: Use the ellipsis package to handle dots
API design: use pass_if() and fail_if()
description:
Intent: use a similar API to the `grader` project, as described in https://github.com/rstudio-education/grader/issues/11

In a nutshell, you should be able to write:

* `initial` contains the initial value
* `pass_if()`
* `fail_if()`

For both `pass_if()` and `fail_if()`, support:

* character vector, and pass if exact match
* function in the traditional form `function(x)...`
* function using formula form `~. == ...`

````
```{r iris, echo=FALSE}
question_parsons(
  initial = c(
    "iris",
    "mutate(...)",
    "summarize(...)",
    "print()"
  ),
  pass_if(
    c(
      "iris",
      "mutate(...)",
      "summarize(...)"
    )
  ),
  pass_if(...),
  fail_if(
    ~length(.) < 2,
    message = "Include at least two answers"
  ),
  fail_if(
    function(x){"print()" %in% x},
    message = "You should not include print() in your answer"
  ),
  fail_if(
    function(x){x[1] != "iris"},
    message = "Your solution should start with 'iris'"
  )
)
```
````
